fields.name: MPSI
fields.description: MPS indicator (MPSI). Bit 1: 0 = Access identity 1 not valid, 1 = Access identity 1 valid. Bits 2, 3, 4 are spare and shall be coded as zero.

notes: The Priority indicator is a type 1 information element.
MPS indicator (MPSI) (octet 1, bit 1): Bit 1: 0 = Access identity 1 not valid, 1 = Access identity 1 valid
Bits 2, 3, 4 are spare and shall be coded as zero.
